title: Amount the Rural Home Loans Escrow Waiver Fee Is Figured On
content:
Loan accounting definition for Rural Home Loans: the amount the escrow waiver fee rate is applied to.

## Definition

The amount the fee rate is applied to is chosen as follows: for a loan open fewer than 60 months, it is the original principal, the loan amount the waiver is priced on; for a loan open 60 months or more whose escrow balance stands below zero, it is the principal balance plus the amount escrow has advanced; otherwise it is the principal balance on the loan record.

| Months open | Escrow balance | Amount figured on |
|---|---|---|
| fewer than 60 | any | the original principal |
| 60 or more | below zero | the principal balance plus the escrow advance |
| 60 or more | zero or above | the principal balance |

- Months open are whole months from the loan's opening date on the loan record to today, a month being completed on the same day of the month as the opening date.
- The escrow advance is the amount by which the escrow balance stands below zero.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical loan: original principal 250000.00, principal balance 212000.00, escrow balance negative 400.00)

| Months open | Amount figured on |
|---|---|
| 59 | 250000.00 |
| 60 | 212400.00 |

Had the escrow balance been 150.00, at 60 months the amount would be 212000.00.
